description: The filters of the dashboard an older report's sync reads, which a burst of the report can vary by: pass their ids in filters to createBurst. Read from the dashboard with your access to its connection, so it can take a few seconds. Find the report's syncs with listReportSyncs. A Rollstack report bursts by report parameters instead: see getReportParameters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

syncId.description: The sync whose dashboard filters to list, by its `id` from `listReportSyncs`.

name: listReportSyncFilters
title: List sync filters
